title: The Yellow Line
subtitle: Fancy Yellow ovals hold their color most fully when white diamonds are placed in immediate contrast. The bracelet was built on that principle: each yellow oval is framed by white baguettes and micro-pavé round brilliants whose white light pushes the warmth of the yellow outward. Every element was chosen to amplify the yellow, none to compete with it.
